verdicts.reason: The note describes a right ankle rolling inward last night playing basketball after landing on a teammate's foot.
The note states a snap followed by rapid lateral swelling.
The note says the patient limped and walked ten to fifteen steps.
The note records ice, elevation and ibuprofen 400 mg this morning.
The note states the left ankle sprain two years ago and no prior right ankle injury.
The patient denies numbness or tingling.
The note states the patient works at a warehouse.
The note matches moderate swelling and bruising over the lateral right ankle.
The note places maximal tenderness over the ATFL.
The note states no malleolar edge or tip tenderness.
The note states no tenderness at the fifth metatarsal base or navicular.
The note states pulses and sensation are normal.
The note states mild laxity on anterior drawer compared with the other side.
The note says the patient took four steps and could bear weight.
The note gives a grade two lateral right ankle sprain.
The note says Ottawa rules do not indicate an X-ray and none is done today.
The note advises elevation and ice for 15 to 20 minutes at a time.
The note covers the air-stirrup brace, crutches for two or three days and weight bearing as tolerated.
The ibuprofen regimen matches.
The note includes a physiotherapy referral for balance and strengthening.
The note expects three to four weeks before return to basketball.
The note provides a work note for one week with no heavy lifting or ladders.
The return precautions match.
